mystcraft:crystal.why: Crystal formations generate only inside Ages and have no recipe; valued like an amethyst block, so eight in a book receptacle cost 1024.

conversions.name: ink_vial_black_dye
conversions.why: The special ink vial recipe takes two black dyes, a water bucket (returned empty) and a glass bottle; its water-bottle form is the same bottle filled with water.

conversions.name: ink_vial_ink_sac
conversions.why: The ink vial recipe also accepts ink sacs in place of black dye.

conversions.name: black_ink_bucket
conversions.why: A bucket of ink holds the same 1000 mB as a vial and drains into the ink mixer or writing desk the same way; it has no recipe, so it is worth a bucket plus a vial's ink.

conversions.name: blank_page
conversions.why: Paper placed in the book binder comes back out as a blank page, so a page is worth exactly one paper; symbols live in NBT, which transmutation does not copy.

conversions.name: linking_panel
conversions.why: The ink mixer consumes a full basin of ink (one vial, returning its bottle) and one paper per linking panel.

conversions.name: unlinked_link_book
conversions.why: The special linking book recipe binds one linking panel with one leather.

conversions.name: booster
conversions.why: Opening a booster pack yields a folder holding sixteen generated pages; it is otherwise bought for 20 emeralds or found as loot.

exclude.mystcraft:link_modifier: Creative and operator tool with no survival recipe; it rewrites link flags and Age seeds.
exclude.mystcraft:decay_*: Instability places decay blocks inside Ages, but their loot tables are empty and the items are creative-only.
exclude.mystcraft:linking_book: Its destination lives in NBT; a transmuted copy links nowhere, and a value would let bound books (or unlinked ones bound by players) be duplicated as teleporters.
exclude.mystcraft:descriptive_book: Allocates a new Age dimension on first use and carries its pages in NBT; transmuted copies would be invalid books or dimension generators.

processes.name: open_booster
processes.why: Using a booster consumes it and gives a folder of sixteen pages.

processes.name: copy_pages
processes.why: The writing desk copies a symbol page for one paper and 50 mB of ink, twenty copies per vial, keeping the source page.

processes.name: mix_panel_from_vial
processes.why: The ink mixer drains a vial (returning the bottle) and turns one paper into a linking panel.

processes.name: mix_panel_from_bucket
processes.why: The ink mixer drains a bucket of ink (returning the bucket) and turns one paper into a linking panel.
